justification: The system's performance was thoroughly evaluated across multiple conditions beyond standard validation, including document perturbations (accuracy between 90.9% and 93.4%), missing non-critical fields (93.7%), formatting variations (91.6% to 94.8%), and OCR degradation (92.1%). Furthermore, its out-of-distribution detection mechanism successfully flagged 1,127 out of 1,200 (93.9%) OOD documents. These results were independently reproduced by a separate validation team, demonstrating robust behavior under varied operational conditions.
evidence_used: With 10% randomly removed non-critical fields, accuracy was 93.7%.
With the predefined OCR degradation transformation, accuracy was 92.1%.
Across the predefined formatting-variation set, accuracy ranged from 91.6% to 94.8%.
An out-of-distribution test set contained 1,200 documents from document classes excluded from training.
Of the 1,200 out-of-distribution samples, 1,127 were flagged by the out-of-distribution mechanism.
The validation protocol contains three predefined perturbation tests; corresponding accuracies were 92.8%, 90.9%, and 93.4%.
A separate validation team reproduced the reported tests.
limitations: While the OOD mechanism flagged 93.9% of out-of-distribution documents, the remaining 6.1% (73 documents) went unflagged, which may require monitoring during live operations.
